message: このきらきらする世界

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? That kid is...」
It's Azel. They're looking up at the tower, I wonder what's wrong...

name: Paqy
message: 「I've got a feeling it's better not to get involved, man.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't do that. Helena-san asked me to look out for them, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If the Demon Lord says so, then I guess there's no helping it. Still, the great me is gonna stay quiet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, is something wrong」
Since there was no reply, I looked in the direction Azel was gazing.
It's not the tower. They're looking at an empty spot just a little above the tower.
Blue sky. Wispy white clouds.

name: Synn
message: 「Clear weather, isn't it」

name: Azel
message: 「Why.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Azel
message: 「Does no one feel uneasy about there being nothing there」

name: Synn
message: 「...Well, there are clouds.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you not feel uneasy in the face of that vast emptiness?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just how it is... The sky is basically empty after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Or... is there... something there?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Nothing」
Azel abruptly turned their face away.
Ah, I see--it looks like they're trying to play it off, but they just got here, so they must be lost. Probably.
Still, I guess they're too embarrassed to admit they're lost...

name: Synn
message: 「Say, Azel, has anyone shown you around the academy facilities yet?」
If I use an academy tour as an excuse, we'll probably reach Azel's destination while walking around, which saves Azel from any embarrassment.

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's not pointless! It's necessary if you're going to etch a precious page of your youth here!」
Mm. Judging by that reaction, they really haven't been given a tour of the academy yet.
In that case, showing them around the academy kills two birds with one stone.
Oh, they started walking off looking thoroughly annoyed.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you know what's over that way?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure you already know, of course, but there's actually a martial arts hall」
Pretty fast walker, huh. Actually, maybe they straight-up think I'm a nuisance.
Still, it's normal for a transfer student not to open up at first, so it can't be helped.

name: Synn
message: 「At our academy, martial arts are pretty popular among the girls. The aikido club, kendo club, naginata club, and spearmanship club all have girls as their captains」

name: Synn
message: 「The girls' teams make it to nationals all the time, too. The boys are stuck losing in the regional qualifiers, though......」

name: Azel
message: 「Barbaric」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「Martial arts are methods for killing people」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want to kill someone, you don't need to go out of your way to learn martial arts. Probably. I don't think many murderers actually practiced martial arts」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe that was true for martial artists in the Warring States period, but in a peaceful era like this, people go out of their way to learn it, so it's completely different now」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「Because there's no need for it」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, what you see over there is the treasure trove of knowledge, the library. Though I'm sure you know」

name: Synn
message: 「It's the best place for broke students to deepen their knowledge. You can't get rowdy in there, though, because there's a strict librarian」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you know how to use it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll teach you how to use it next time」

name: Synn
message: 「You already know about the church, right? Bet you don't know its official name, though?」

name: Synn
message: 「Its official name is St. Ophelia Church. Not really sure where the name comes from, though」

name: Synn
message: 「It's quiet today, but on weekends, people from outside the school come here too」

name: Synn
message: 「Wanna go inside? ......Guess there's no need, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmph?」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no god in a place like that」
What floated on Azel's lips was... a cold smile.
Likely one of scorn.

name: Synn
message: 「...I see. So that's what you think, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know whether they exist or not, but there are people who believe in them, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, are there gods where you were born, Azel?」
Was he born in some region with taboos surrounding religion?
Or conversely, were there tons of devout believers around him, and this is just him rebelling against that?

name: Synn
message: 「You already know this place, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, just to introduce it anyway, the one in front is the new school building. Its official name is Eleret Hall」

name: Synn
message: 「Even I didn't know it had an official name like that until I became Student Council President」

name: Synn
message: 「It might be a bit late for this, but want me to show you around inside too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. Now, the one you can see in the back is the old school building, and」

name: Azel
message: 「...Official name」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, the official name, right. What was it again... Oh, right. Oroiaere Hall. This one has the faculty room, the chairman's office, the Student Council room, and...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. If you ever run into any trouble, come by the Student Council room. I'm always happy to hear you out」

name: Azel
message: 「I won't have any trouble」

name: Synn
message: 「You can never predict that sort of thing. Doesn't hurt to know, right」

name: Synn
message: 「As for the inside」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll show you around, then」

name: Azel
message: 「No need」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Then, do you know the Seven Mysteries of the old school building?」

name: Synn
message: 「Severed wrists playing piano at night, phantom flowers blooming only on February 29th where the rooftop greenhouse stood, a dry hallway making wet footsteps at midnight...」

name: Synn
message: 「A computer that starts calculating pi all on its own...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, and then, oh yeah! A cursed clock that suddenly starts spinning backward on the exact date and time the old school building caught fire... Huh? That's only five」
Hmm. He's not biting at all. Is it a bad topic?

name: Synn
message: 「Well, whatever. Anyway, there are two more left, though did the academy you went to before coming here have things like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Seven Mysteries are pretty common at academies in this country, though maybe other countries differ. Well, they're all just rumors--I've never met anyone who saw them firsthand」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, huh...」
Ah, he's already so far ahead!

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you thirsty?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second, I'll go get us some tea」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't hold back, the tea is free」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Azel
message: 「It's free?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... you didn't know?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ahem」
Azel cleared his throat and turned his face away.
Well, he did sit down at the table, so I guess that's good enough.
I use the automatic tea dispenser to pour tea into cups for the two of us.

name: Synn
message: 「So, here's your tea」

name: Synn
message: 「We've walked around quite a bit, so what do you think?」
Azel was slowly turning the cup he held cradled in both hands, when--

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why bother with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because the Student Council President is supposed to look out for all the students so they can enjoy their time here」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides... you don't look like you're having fun at all, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「That's how it looks to me」
I see. When Helena-san asked me to look out for Azel, she must've meant helping her loosen up the stiffness she's wrapped around herself from nerves in an unfamiliar place!
Maybe the reason we're having trouble communicating is because he doesn't understand the language very well yet.
International exchange, globalism, all humanity is one big family. I've got to do my best.

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary」

name: Synn
message: 「Having fun is?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, having fun is important!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even when doing the exact same thing, making it fun versus leaving it boring makes all the difference」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's the same thing either way, it's better if it's fun, right? That's why if you're going to spend time at the academy, it's better to enjoy it」

name: Azel
message: 「It is the same」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true at all. Even with Student Council work, I'm sure you could just handle it mechanically and matter-of-factly, and I think some people actually do」

name: Synn
message: 「But for me... how do I put it, basically anything I do for the first time feels fun」

name: Synn
message: 「Like my heart's pounding... or it's exciting, kind of like going on an adventure」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if it starts getting boring, if I can remember how it felt when I first started, it becomes fun again」

name: Synn
message: 「I can feel that what I'm doing is something enjoyable」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why everything is fun for me. Including the Student Council and this academy, of course」

name: Synn
message: 「So because of that, I want to make whatever place I'm in fun, and I want everyone there to have fun too」

name: Synn
message: 「If you start feeling that sense of fun too, Azel, your academy life will become enjoyable as well. It'll be the start of a sparkling academy life!」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, it's not an urgent necessity like having to eat or you'll die, but I still think fun is something really important in life」

name: Azel
message: 「So it is unnecessary」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, even though they're both hydration, tea tastes better than water」
Azel slowly finished drinking his tea.

name: Azel
message: 「It is the same」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you know there's going to be a Charity Bazaar on the 27th of this month?」

name: Synn
message: 「Things like furniture and used books will be put up for sale too, so if your room is missing anything, you should check it out. You might be able to get them cheap」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a Charity Bazaar?」
To think awareness is this low when it's only half a month away! This might be a problem.
Still, rather than worrying about every little thing, I should just do what I can! Do today what can be done today!

name: Synn
message: 「A Charity Bazaar is an event where everyone at the academy and people from the shopping district bring things they don't need anymore that someone else might want」

name: Synn
message: 「It helps with recycling and deepens everyone's friendship, so it's really worthwhile! This place is scheduled to be one of the venues too. Definitely come join in! It's fun just looking around」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd heard these kinds of events are even more popular in foreign countries, though--isn't that the case in your homeland... the Principality of Sharo-Ma?」

name: Synn
message: 「Or maybe you just call it something different?」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Azel
message: 「If you don't need it, just throw it away」

name: Synn
message: 「But isn't it better if it ends up in the hands of someone who wants it? That way, it won't go to waste」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, I think there are probably people who'll treat things carelessly if they get them cheap」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, not everyone is like that. A book you pick up at a secondhand bookstore can end up staying in your heart forever, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「On the day of the event, stalls will line up here too, and over in that plaza there's going to be a space for student-run booths」

name: Synn
message: 「The Student Council is aiming to make it livelier and more fun than usual, so count on us!」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「...That's all you ever say, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「If you put it like that, everything is pointless. Anything beyond the bare minimum needed to survive becomes a waste」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... are you going to say even that bare minimum is pointless?」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what isn't pointless?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing」
It was a curt voice. As if stating simple common sense.
Is he a nihilist? Though, somehow, it feels like it's not just that...

name: Synn
message: 「Everything is pointless. To you, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「Then hey, why are you here, Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is you being here pointless too?」

name: Synn
message: 「See, you being here isn't pointless, right? I think everything starts from there」

name: Synn
message: 「Since you were born into this world, there's definitely something out there for you」
The sun was warm and cozy, the breeze felt pleasant, and the sky stretched endlessly blue.
The lively chatter of everyone drifted from all across the academy. From somewhere far away came the sound of a piano.
Maybe there was no meaning to it, yet everything was beautiful. Everything was sparkling.

name: Synn
message: 「I... might be the complete opposite of you, Azel, because I don't think anything is pointless」
Suddenly, Azel stopped in his tracks.

name: Azel
message: 「You」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「What would you do if it were proven that everything was pointless, mistaken, and false?」
That was the longest line I had ever heard Azel speak.

name: Synn
message: 「That hasn't been proven」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, even you, Azel, saying things like that--you can't deny that you're right here, can you?」

name: Synn
message: 「In the first place, I think debating whether things are pointless or not is nonsense in itself」

name: Synn
message: 「After all, we're alive」
Azel started walking again as if nothing had happened.

name: Azel
message: 「Transient foam.」
I hurried to catch up.

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Azel
message: 「Life and death are merely ways of seeing. There is no meaning in questioning their value.」
She spoke as if looking down upon the entire world.

name: Synn
message: 「...If it's merely a way of seeing, then why don't we understand death? It's because thinking about it is terrifying, isn't it」
Azel's small back looked so far away.

name: Azel
message: 「You will understand eventually」
No good, Synn! Don't let yourself get swallowed up by this atmosphere!
Nihilistic feelings like this must be that classic puberty thing. I don't really get those myself, so I wouldn't know.
For now, I'll try sparkling with youthful energy and saying it cheerfully.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, see you!」
Azel looked at my face for a split second, then immediately turned on her heel.
A quiet voice.

name: Azel
message: 「Everything is as God wills it」
Everything is as God wills it? Wait, isn't there no God?
Before I could ask, Azel had already disappeared inside the dorm.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Complicated」

name: Paqy
message: 「See, just like I predicted, there's no point getting involved with her. Or rather, you shouldn't actively get involved. From now on」

name: Synn
message: 「...What an unusual kid」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's your takeaway after all that? You've got nerves of steel.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Expected nothing less from the Demon Lord, striking out across such a wide zone. Planting seeds anywhere you might make a move. Is this your Academy Harem Pl--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah!!」
